cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 81% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Oilfield Services lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.74%; weakest is Oilfield Services at +0.06%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: HUBB is the standout at +4.37%
cards.body: Leaders: HUBB +4.37%, CCJ +2.20%, VRT +1.94%, UUUU +1.91%, FLNC +1.84%. Laggards: SLB -0.98%, FTI -0.89%, BEP -0.60%, XOM -0.17%.
